dimensions.rationale: Major sections are identifiable, but the pre-repair page used noisy typography and repeated bordered containers.
The pre-repair lifecycle disclosure and consequential form controls did not communicate their intent clearly enough.
Primary tasks were centralized, but the pre-repair moderation and EXP workflows lacked adequate review guidance.
Desktop alignment was orderly, while compact table navigation lacked a visible interaction cue.
The pre-repair leaderboard emphasized total XP even though season points determine displayed rank.
The pre-repair consequential forms depended on placeholders rather than persistent labels.

component_reviews.rationale: Rank semantics and compact scroll affordance required repair.
The lifecycle disclosure and inactive governance states were insufficiently explicit.
The rationale control and consequential resolution actions required clearer presentation.
The supplied pre-repair evidence did not establish a premium-quality ranking-control state.
The supplied pre-repair evidence did not establish a premium-quality audit state.
The modal was coherent but lacked persistent labels and explicit audited-adjustment guidance.

findings.observation: Total XP was visually primary although season points determine rank order.
findings.user_impact: Administrators could reasonably conclude that the leaderboard ordering was incorrect.
findings.repair_direction: Make season points primary and total XP secondary.
findings.verification: Verify descending season points align with the displayed rank.

findings.observation: The manual EXP workflow relied on placeholders for consequential fields.
findings.user_impact: Field meaning becomes harder to recover after values are entered.
findings.repair_direction: Add persistent labels and explicit audited-action guidance.
findings.verification: Open the modal and inspect all labels before member selection.
